notes: Explicit POC issuer/instrument configuration for Taiwan exchange adapters. A four-digit code shape does NOT prove a common share: depositary receipts, ETFs, REITs, preferred and beneficiary certificates can also carry four-digit codes. The adapters therefore refuse any ticker without an entry here. `verified_by` records who established the instrument type and how; `assistant-poc-declaration` is an explicitly scoped project configuration for the Phase 0 targets, NOT an official instrument-type feed and NOT a human attestation. Before adding issuers, record an official instrument-type source (for example the TWSE/TPEx ISIN registration service) in `evidence`, or mark the entry as unsupported.
